name: AddonNest for Elementor
author: TheBitCraft

sections.description:
AddonNest is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to extend the functionality of Elementor, the popular page builder. It provides a collection of 20+ premium widgets and addons to enhance your website design with advanced features, dynamic content, and stunning visual elements.

Whether you’re building a business website, portfolio, eCommerce store, and blog, AddonNest offers versatile widgets to create engaging and interactive layouts effortlessly.

Features

🔥 20+ Powerful Elementor Widgets: Expand your design possibilities with a diverse collection of high-quality widgets, from sliders and countdowns to dynamic galleries and pricing tables.
🔥 Enhance Your Website Design with Ease: Create visually stunning layouts without any hassle—perfect for businesses, portfolios, eCommerce, and more.
🔥 Fully Customizable & Responsive: Every widget is fully adjustable to match your brand, with mobile-friendly designs that look great on all devices.
🔥 Fast, Lightweight & Optimized for Performance: Built with clean code to ensure fast loading times and smooth performance without slowing down your site.
🔥 Seamless Integration with Elementor: Works flawlessly with both Elementor Free & Pro, giving you more flexibility in your page-building process.
🔥 No Coding Required – Drag & Drop Simplicity: Intuitive controls let you design like a pro—just drag, drop, and customize in real-time.
🔥 Elevate Your Elementor Experience with AddonNest: Take your website to the next level with professional-grade widgets that save time and boost engagement.
🔥 Regular Updates – Continuous improvements and new widget additions.

20+ Free Elementor Addons

We’ve crafted over 20 powerful widgets to elevate your Elementor page-building experience and help you unlock your full design potential.

  1. Blog List
  2. Hero Video
  3. AddonNest Slider
  4. AddonNest TimeLine
  5. Countdown
  6. Team Members
  7. AddonNest Title
  8. Animated Headine
  9. Breaking News
  10. Call Contact Form
  11. Events List
  12. Features Addon
  13. Media Card
  14. Navigating Features
  15. Online Delivery Banner
  16. Photo Gallery
  17. Pricing Table
  18. Product Categories Grid
  19. Restaurant Menu
  20. Restaurant Schedule
  21. Services
  22. Shop Banner
  23. Special Menu
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP version 5.6.0 or greater (PHP 7.4 or greater is recommended)
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater (MySQL 5.6 or greater is recommended)

Automatic installation

The automatic installation is the easiest way to install any plugin in WordPress. You can perform an automatic installation by logging in to your WordPress dashboard, navigating to the “Plugins” menu and clicking on the “Add New” button.

This will open up a page showing all the available plugins in WordPress. In the search field, type AddonNest. The search result will show you our AddonNest plugin. You can then see the detailed info by clicking on “More Details” and to install just click on the “Install Now” button.

Manual installation

Go to Dashboard > Plugins > Add New, then upload addonnest.zip file and click Install Now.
sections.faq:
Q. Where can I get support?

A. You can get support by posting on the support section of this plugin on the WordPress plugin directory, or via email at: hello@thebitcraft.com

Q. Can I use my existing WordPress theme?

A. Sure, you can use your existing WordPress theme with AddonNest.

Q. Where can I report a bug?

A. Found a bug? Please let us know by posting on the support section of this plugin on the WordPress plugin directory or directly via email at: hello@thebitcraft.com
